title: Rock Band cinema staff Announces Disbandment After 21 Years
content: The official website of cinema staff announced on Wednesday that the four-member rock band will disband on September 12, 2027, following their final one-man live concert at Toyasu PIT in Tokyo.

title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System Episode 13 Preview Revealed
content: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System has revealed the preview for Episode 13 ahead of its September 24 premiere. The series is streaming on Crunchyroll and previously confirmed two consecutive cours . Studio GoHands is in charge of the animation.

title: Cyberpunk Edgerunners 2 Anime's New Video Teases Escape from Akasaka
content: Netflix streamed a new "sneak peek" video, teasing an escape scene from an Arasaka building, from the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime on Tuesday.
